ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximate 40:60 ratio of high-intensity white (distal regions) to low-intensity black (medial/central regions) visible above the waterline.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous low-intensity black central region extending from the base; transitions into high-intensity white distal lobes featuring irregular black mottling and dense linear streaks concentrated near the outer boundaries.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration along the superior trailing edge with irregular pixel-amplitude peaks and valleys; most pronounced on the right lobe distal edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave upward curvature extending from the central region toward the dorsal tips of both fluke lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of high-contrast, multi-colored (brown, white, grey) circular pixel groups located at the extreme distal tips of both the left and right lobes, consistent with barnacle colonization.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple dark, unaligned linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) visible on the white distal regions; specifically, a series of roughly parallel vertical lines on the right lobe and intersecting diagonal lines on the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent surface-level traumatic linear markings (rake marks) and substantial barnacle clusters localized on the terminal ends of the lobes.
